title: The Evidence Room
story: Someone left a messy folder called ~/archive/ with hundreds of files inside. Only one of them is the real evidence. Find it, put it where it belongs, and clean up the rest.
description:
Locate the .evd file inside ~/archive/ containing the exact phrase a3da2_sherket_nvidia_microntech and move it into ~/evidence/ (create the folder if needed).

Delete the ~/archive/decoy_trap directory completely.

Find the researcher handle with the highest numeric score in ~/archive/scores.txt and save that handle inside a new file in ~/evidence/.

Run quest check to claim your flag.
hints: Search for `.evd` files inside `~/archive/` and search inside them for the exact word `a3da2_sherket_nvidia_microntech`.
Create `~/evidence/`, move the matching `.evd` file into `~/evidence/`, and delete `~/archive/decoy_trap` recursively.
Sort `~/archive/scores.txt` numerically, save the handle with the highest score into a new file inside `~/evidence/`, and run `quest check`.
